concept: EC2 Spot: ASG mixed instances policy across instance types and AZs
tests: Resilient, cheap compute for interruptible batch jobs with automatic replacement of interrupted capacity.
expected: Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group with a mixed instances policy + diversification across several instance types and AZs for better Spot capacity availability. Triggers: "tolerate interruption and restart", "cost-aware", "automatically replaces interrupted capacity", (Choose two).
why_not: A single On-Demand instance is neither resilient nor cost-optimal; Dedicated Hosts are expensive and add no resilience.
